4cfcb62e1aa6714a.desc: Sara Bareilles first achieved mainstream critical praise in 2007 with her widely successful hit, "Love Song" which reached #1 in 22 countries around the world from her debut album "Little Voice." Since then, the Eureka, CA native has gone on to sell over a million copies of her debut album, and earn three Grammy nominations, including Song of the Year and Best Female Pop Vocal Performance for "Love Song." Bareilles' critically acclaimed sophomore release "Kaleidoscope Heart," released in September 2010, debuted at #1 on the Billboard top 200 chart and has gained critical praise everywhere including the New York Times, Wall Street Journal, People and Los Angeles Times. The album yielded the hit single "King of Anything," which earned a Grammy nomination for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance and was certified platinum by the RIAA. In 2011, Bareilles joined the judging panel on the hit NBC show "The Sing-Off."

4cd7cb71b3b8e4f8.title: Divorce Care Higher Vision Church
4cd7cb71b3b8e4f8.desc: No matter how amiable, separation or divorce is one of the most painful experiences. But you are not alone: there is a DivorceCare support group for people walking through separation or divorce. DivorceCare is a safe, welcoming place where people understand the difficult emotions and challenges of separation and divorce. Over 13 weeks, you’ll find relief and comfort as you learn what to expect in the days ahead and how to navigate your personal healing journey. Since separation and divorce can be messy and confusing, you’ll learn helpful ways of coping with the challenges and navigating relationships—and gain solid support each step of the way. Topics include how to manage divorce-related emotions such as loneliness, anxiety, bitterness, anger, and grief; how to cope with the changes in your life and relationships; the importance of forgiveness; and how to navigate legal and financial issues. At a weekly DivorceCare meeting, you will view a video featuring respected counselors, teachers, and healthcare professionals on divorce and recovery topics. In her corner: a razor-sharp wit, volcanic passion, and a Brooklyn brownstone where she’s barricaded with enough Molotov cocktails to take out the entire block. Her children have a secret weapon of their own: estranged son Chris, who returns after 20 years to become the family’s unlikely mediator. But no sooner are the words “Hi, Mom” spoken than the emotional bombs begin to detonate. “The Velocity of Autumn” is a wickedly funny and deeply touching exploration of the fragility - and ferocity - of life. There are eight shows to choose from Friday, October 9, 2026 - Sunday, October 18, 2026.
